title: Lime washing a culm
description: The change a lime wash makes on cane and bamboo, slaked lime turning into calcium carbonate, and why it protects the culm.

u0002.text: Slaked lime on the culm turns into calcium carbonate.

u0003.text: From slaked lime to calcium carbonate, as the source states it

u0004.text: The carbonate inhibits water absorption and delays fungal attack.

C060.text: Lime washing coats culms and mats with slaked lime, which turns into calcium carbonate that inhibits water absorption and delays fungal attack.

quotes.quote: Culms and mats are painted with slaked lime(Ca(OH) ) which is then transformed 2 into calcium carbonate, CaCO , which inhibits water absorption and 3 delays fungal attack.
Slaked lime makes the surface of treated bamboo alkaline. This delays the attack of fungi.
